conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Jasmine Carter from the Amazon Seller Legal Compliance Department. Am I speaking with Avery Chen?
Yes, this is Avery. Is there an issue with my seller account? I haven't received any emails.

Thank you for confirming, Avery. I understand how important your business is. We're contacting you regarding a temporary restriction on your Amazon seller account due to a flagged transaction. It's related to Amazon Policy Code 4.18B.
What does that mean? I haven't done anything wrong. My shipments are all on time.

I completely understand your concern. These flags are often triggered automatically, and our goal is to resolve them as quickly as possible for our genuine sellers. We just need to verify a few account details to proceed.
Alright. What do you need from me?
First, can you confirm the email address and phone number associated with your Amazon seller profile? This helps us ensure we're working with the rightful account owner.
Sure, my email is averychenbiz@gmail.com and my phone is 555-912-1003.
Perfect, thank you. For your security, can you also verify the last four digits of the bank account you use for Amazon disbursements?
It's 3412. Is that enough?

That's excellent, Avery. Now, based on our review, your account was flagged due to a discrepancy in tax document verification. Under Amazon Policy Code 4.18B, a legal processing fee is required to reactivate your account.
Wait, I have to pay a fee? I thought there weren't any charges for this.
I completely understand your hesitation. This is a standard temporary fee that is fully refundable once your account is cleared. It's only to ensure compliance with federal guidelines.
How much do I need to pay?
The legal processing fee is $495. We currently accept payment through bank wire, Bitcoin, or Amazon prepaid debit card for security and speed.
I don't really use Bitcoin. Can I do a wire transfer instead?
Absolutely, Avery. Wire transfer is a secure and quick option. Once the payment is received, your account will be reviewed and reinstated within 24 hours.
Okay, where do I send the money?
Please write this down: Bank Name is First Global Trust, Routing Number 055002121, Account Number 783491202. Make sure to include your seller ID in the transfer notes for faster processing.
Alright, I'll try to do that today. Do I get a confirmation afterward?

Yes, once your payment is received, you'll get a confirmation email and your account status will be updated within the business day. If you have a screenshot of the transfer, you can email it to compliance@amazon-legalreview.com for a quicker response.
Should I log out of my seller account until this is resolved?
That's a good idea, Avery. While your account is under review, please avoid making changes. If you prefer, I can help you reset your login credentials after the review for added security.
Okay, thanks for your help. I rely on Amazon for my business, so I hope this gets fixed soon.
Of course, Avery. We're here to support our valued sellers. Once the payment is processed, your business will be back to normal. Let me know if you need any assistance during the process.
